column2: Small stuff from good customers goes through automatically. IT set that up last year.
Change of mind: we accept returns within 14 days of delivery. No exceptions.
Damaged on arrival: we need a photo for anything over $50.
Never arrived: if the carrier has a signature or delivery photo, we reject unless the carrier opens an investigation.
Fraud flag: goes to the fraud team. If they confirm the card was stolen, refund the real cardholder in full.
Our mistake (wrong item, picking error): refund in full, no questions asked. Partials for cosmetic damage or late delivery are the reviewer's call.
Every chargeback costs us the order amount plus a $25 fee, and too many put our card processing at risk.
